newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Cargo ship in distress off Lithuania.
newsitem.headline: Cargo ship in distress off Lithuania.

text.p: Lithuania's coastguard was mounting a rescue mission on Thursday after a cargo ship with 20 crew aboard sent a distress signal in high winds off the country's Baltic coast, the Baltic News Service (BNS) reported.
BNS reported that the 5,970-ton Silvia, registered in St Vincent, asked for help saying it had engine problems and that winds were driving it ashore.

A Lithuanian air force helicopter was on alert at the port of Klaipeda to evacuate the crew from the troubled ship which was struggling through six-metre (20 foot) waves. BNS said coastguard officials were concerned the ship could be grounded on a sand bar.
